04.steps:
1) Login to management interface through a web browser

2) Go to Network/Address Object page

3) Create an address object (host) called as IP1

4) Create an address object (range) called as Range1

5) Create an address Group object called as Tansparent Group1 including IP1 and Range1

6) Configure an interface as Transparent Mo de using Transparent Group1 as transparent range for this interface from Network/Interface page

7) Click OK button to save change

8) Repeat Step 3 to Step 15 in TC-3 above to modify IP1 or Range1

9) Repeat the steps above for other Interfaces defined in LAN, DMZ or custome zone

04.result: The modification for this tansparent range is only allowed within WAN subnet (WAN IP excluded) , otherwise, it will be denied with an proper error message.
